title: Repository project execution definition
description: Repository-owned preparation, verification, release identity, cache-path, capability, environment, development-server, and optional image composition read from .agent-studio/project.yml at the subject commit.

stack.description: Technology building blocks used by the project.

toolVersions.description: Tool names mapped to repository-relative version manifests such as .nvmrc or global.json.

commands.description: Preparation and verification commands shared by coding runs and build-test gates.

prepare.description: Repository-relative POSIX prepare script. Windows runs a sibling '<prepare>.ps1' when the repository ships one, otherwise the POSIX script through Git Bash; a Windows host with neither fails with the named reason 'prepare:windows-entry-missing'.

testSuites.description: Named test inventory with operator-facing category and expected duration.

cachePaths.description: Repository-relative generated paths that preparation may populate.

capabilities.description: Executor capabilities required by the project.

environment.description: Non-secret preparation environment values. Executor profiles supply secrets.

devServer.description: Optional bounded development-server lifecycle owned by the run.

image.description: Optional repository-relative container image definition used only by a container executor profile.

release.description: Optional Stable release contract. Stable release tooling refuses a project when this section is absent.

restore.description: Ordered, fail-fast restore commands executed from the tagged checkout.

releaseIdentity.description: One package identity, sourced either from a committed lock file or from an exact version plus registry integrity.
